about: Hole 2: shot just misses the bunker ('I hate to call a spade a spade… unbelievably poor performance'), then the putts → 'wow, a double?' → 'we're plus three going into three, that's tough.' Opens on the shot (no talking for the first ~6 s). Original audio, swearing kept, no added text, vertical 1080x1920.
caption: a double on a par 2 is crazy work. full video on my channel
title: OLD single-moment cut: double on hole two
